description: Verify SvGrid code BEFORE handing it to the user. Checks the source against the real exported surface of the current version - <SvGrid> prop names, ColumnDef keys, grid API methods, importable symbols and theme files - plus Svelte 5 runes rules, and returns line-numbered diagnostics with the exact replacement for each. Run it on every file you write that uses SvGrid, fix what it reports, and run it again.

filename.description: File name, used to pick which rules apply. Defaults to "Component.svelte".

source.description: The full file contents to check.

name: check_svgrid_code
